text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye is an absolutely flawless Umamusume.
That fact is well-known even among Trainers.

And as for how true that is... you will learn
soon enough as you spend time at Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
—My, perfect scores across every subject again.
You really are brilliant, Ai-san.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because I don't wanna lose over a single point.
If you get a perfect score, you're safe, right?
choice_data_list: (Perfect scores in every subject... Truly impressive.)

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: ! Ai, look at this! It's that carrot rose we saw on TV together the other day!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Well, you looked like you really wanted some! Plus, I wanted to try making it myself, too.
And then, one day after school――

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye & Others
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Lilac & Blast
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...!
Almond Eye and the others asked me to assist with their tandem training, and as I watched over them...
choice_data_list: (Both the result and the race itself were flawless...)

text_block_list.text:
The result was a total blowout by Almond Eye.
Left speechless by her flawless performance, I stood stunned for a moment.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ――Alright, my win!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Haaah... Terrifying, honestly... You'd think they could go a wee bit easy on me in training, at least.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Fufu. I hate losing, so no way. Besides, I didn't have the luxury to hold back anyway!

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
? Really?
Boo, it didn't look like that at all!
choice_data_list: I thought it was practically flawless, but...
I thought it was pretty much perfect too, but...

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
No. ...First of all, Lala was
marking her targets way better than before.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Blast's closing burst has gotten
even sharper.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Both of them are definitely improving. This is no time to be pulling any punches.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to fall behind either!
choice_data_list: I could really learn from that mental resilience.
Maybe having no openings is the secret to your speed.
Perhaps having no openings is the secret behind your speed.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I can't afford to fall behind either!
choice_data_list: I could really learn from that mental resilience.
Maybe having no openings is the secret to your speed.
Perhaps having no openings is the secret behind your speed.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text:
Uh-huh, uh-huh! But you gotta be careful!
If a human tries to copy Ai, you'll collapse!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I can't... exactly say that's untrue.
I often get so absorbed that I get lightheaded in the bath...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
She's truly terrifying, isn't she?
No matter how many times she wins, she's never satisfied in the slightest.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to win a ton!
...Come on, let's do one more set♪
